Amherst Town Court

Address: 400 John James Audubon Pkwy, Buffalo, NY 14228, United States

Phone: 716-689-4200716-689-4201

Amherst Town Court is in Erie County, New York, and is one of that county's 36 towns and villages. The court is in the 8th and 4th Judicial District Court department and provides service in the town of Amherst. It usually deals with traffic matters, small claims, eviction and civil matters, and criminal offenses. Primary service that this town court will give our community court traffic and small claims matters. Cases are assigned at the date of offense by the judges.

Cases:

Amherst Town Court deals with these cases and services:

  • Bail cases
  • Parking and traffic tickets
  • Warrants cases
  • Eviction cases
  • Small claims cases
  • Conviction and disposition certificate
  • Civil and criminal cases

Eviction:

Amherst Town Court Eviction is the service provided by the town court. A person can hire an attorney with experience in eviction cases for guidance. Rent Non-payment eviction process is:

  • The court is unbiased on the case and does not help a person execute the required form.
  • It is suggested to hire an attorney. Download the form from http://nycourts.gov/courthelp/ if you do not hire an attorney.
  • A person's request is served after 14 days. Available eviction date is obtained from the court.
  • A petition is served.
  • Filing fees for the petition notice is $20.
  • Take the completed warrant and judgment to the court for the judge to sign.

Case Search:

Amherst Town Court Case Search can be done online using first and last name, city, and State name, i.e., New York. After filling in all the information, a person can get the case information.

see also Weld County Court

Ticket Payment:

Amherst Town Court ticket payment can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can pay ticket fees by going to the court during business hours and paying at the front counter of the court.

Online

Online ticket payments can only be made using the website http://www.paycourtonline.com/; a service fee is also included in this online system.

Mail

The ticket can also be paid by sending the court money orders or credit card information. The mailing address of the town court is 400 John James Audubon Pkwy, Buffalo, NY 14228, United States.

How to apply for bail?

Amherst Town Court provides service in the matter of bail. The bail form is available on the Town Court website, and the fee for filling the form is $3. The bail money is returned to the person when the case is completed. Bails are posted at the facility where the defendant is held, and you have to keep your bail receipt as proof. Contact the bail office for any information.

Phone: 716-689-4215.

Certification of disposition:

Amherst Town Court certification of disposition can be gotten from the Town Court in the following ways:

In-Person

Come to the courthouse front counter from 8:30 am to 3:30 pm with your photo. Complete the form provided by the court. Provide the exact date of arrest and all the information regarding the case. $5 is the fee for the certification.

Mail

Download the certification of the disposition form and fill it out. Provide all the information regarding the case. Signatures provided on the form are verified for the release of sealed information by the public notary. Mail the form with your photo Id and $5 fees to the town court address.

How to File Small Claims?

Small claims can be filed by any person or DBA; the only restriction is that the person you are claiming your case must be a resident of Amherst, and the claim must be under $3000. After filing the case, papers and dates will be assigned by the court. $10 is the filing fee for claims under $1000 and $15 for claims under $3000.The guidance and Application form is available on the court website. Contact on 716-689-4218 for any information related to small claims.

see also Boulder County District Court

How to get a Marriage License?

Amherst Town Court marriage license is provided by the town clerk. The marriage license is only obtained if you have an appointment. Fill out the Application form online, and then an appointment schedule is given to the couple. Contact 716-631-7021 one hour before your appointment for confirmation and bring the original document and photo ID for identification at the court. $10 is the fee for each copy of the marriage license certification.

FAQ

What are some rules in Amherst Town Court?

Amherst Town Court rules are:

  • It is recommended not to bring children during court sessions.
  • Electronic equipment like mobile phones, backpacks, luggage, and food are not allowed in the court.
  • Dress appropriately. Wear a suit or dress that is presentable and comfortable. Avoid sleeveless short shorts, sandals, hats, and sunglasses on the court.

How can I get information related to a criminal background check?

You can get information about a criminal background check by contacting the Police Department of Amherst. The department is located at 500 John James Audubon Pkwy Amherst, NY 14228.

Phone: 716-689-1311

Which type of identity documents are required to get a marriage license?

Documents that prove your identification, like Driver License, Passport, or immigration record, are mandatory for the marriage license.

How can I contact the Town Clerk?

You can visit the town clerk from Monday to Friday from 8:30 am to 4:00 pm at 5583 Main St Williamsville, NY 14221, or contact at 716-631-7021 for any information.

What happens if I plead guilty?

Suppose you plead guilty, then a fine or surcharges are assessed against you. The fine letter will be mailed to your address.

What would I do if I received a traffic ticket regarding an appearance in court?

Contact the Amherst Town Court if you received a traffic ticket regarding an appearance in court.

When do I have to appear in court?

It is mandatory to appear in court for the following cases:

  • If you are involved in a Misdemeanor Offense case
  • If you are involved in any violation case.
